_comment: Hardware configs for scripts/gen_random_workload.py.
Each entry's machines/profile_hw/profile are copied verbatim into the
generated workload's `hardware` block.
Reconstructed from the distinct `hardware` blocks in data/toplevel/*.json
(the generator emits them verbatim, so the shipped workloads are the
authoritative record of what this file held).
`p_core_speedup` is deliberately absent: generate() copies only
machines/profile_hw/profile, and the generator refuses to emit a speedup
on top of profiled CSVs.
`available: false` marks configs whose profile CSVs the generator cannot
reach: find_profile_csv() hardcodes <repo>/gen/profile and ignores the
`profile.gen_root` key that profile_metrics.py honours.
`single_core`/`dual_core`/`quad_core` scale both machine kinds together
(1, 2 and 4 cores of each).  build_machine_combinations() turns a kind with
N cores into groups of 1..N cores whose topo tag is derived from the group
size, but qrb5165_v66 only has topo_0 profiles on disk -- so these entries
pin `topo_tag_override: true`, and every group reads the single-core
measurement.  Extra cores therefore buy dispatch-level parallelism, not an
intra-dispatch speedup.  Re-profile at topo_0_1 / topo_0_1_2_3 and drop the
override to model multi-hart groups.

qrb5165_hetero.description: QRB5165 v66: HTA + DSP + CPU, one core each

qrb5165_hetero_topo_pinned.description: QRB5165 v66, topo_tag pinned rather than derived

spike_het.description: Spike ISA sim: RVV p-core + scalar e-core
unavailable_reason: gen/profile/{RVV,scalar}/spike/ exist but hold no results.csv.

firesim_gemmini_q31.description: FireSim rocket+saturn: gemmini_q31 p-core + V256D128 RVV e-core
unavailable_reason: which adds a sweep-name level find_profile_csv() does not expect.

firesim_gemmini.description: FireSim rocket+saturn: gemmini p-core + RVV e-core

firesim_rvv.description: FireSim rocket+saturn: RVV on both cores

firesim_het.description: FireSim rocket+saturn: RVV p-core + scalar e-core

spacemit_x60_quad.description: SpaceMiT X60: RVV p-core + scalar e-core, 4-core topology
unavailable_reason: the spacemit_x60 dispatch graphs referenced by data/toplevel are not
on disk (gen/vmfb/... and profiled/gen/vmfb/... are both missing),
and there is no gen/profile tree for this target.
